## Changes

Describe the user-visible behavior and affected components.

## Testing

List builds/tests run and, for rendering fixes, the GPU/driver/game used.
Do not claim real hardware testing if only a compile or code review was performed.

## Public repository checklist

- [ ] No console keys, game images, firmware, proprietary dumps, credentials, or personal information were added (including in logs, screenshots and commit messages).
- [ ] Any imported/upstream code is attributed and follows its applicable license; original license headers remain intact.
- [ ] Any crash log, frame capture or shader dump was checked for private paths, IDs and copyrighted content before sharing.
- [ ] The change preserves safe fallbacks and has a concrete regression test or a clear explanation when hardware testing is unavailable.

Do not merge based only on an AI review. Independent builds and on-device testing may still be required.
